texts.2.2: JESU, MARIA - I am near to death,
texts.2.3: And Thou art calling me; I know it now.
texts.2.4: Not by the token of this faltering breath,
texts.2.5: This chill at heart,, this dampness on my
texts.2.6: brow,-- (Jesu, have mercy! Mary, pray for me!)
texts.2.7: 'tis this new feeling, never felt before,
texts.2.8: (Be with me, Lord, in my extremity!)
texts.2.9: That I am going, that I am no more.
texts.2.11: (Lover of souls! great God! I look to Thee,)
texts.2.12: This emptying out of each constituent
texts.2.13: And natural force, by which I come to be.
texts.2.14: Pray for me, my friends; a visitant
texts.2.15: Is knocking his dire summons at my door,
texts.2.16: The like of whom, to scare me and to daunt,
texts.2.17: Has never, never come to me before;
texts.2.18: us death,--O loving friends, your prayers!-- tis he!
texts.2.19: As though my very being had given way,
texts.2.20: As though I was no more a substance now,
texts.2.21: And could fall back on nought to be my stay,
texts.2.22: (Help, loving Lord! Thou my sole Refuge,
texts.2.24: And turn no whither, but must needs decay
texts.2.25: And drop from out the universal frame
texts.2.26: Into that shapeless, scopeless, blank abyss,
texts.2.27: That utter nothingness, of which I came:
texts.2.28: This is it that has come to pass in me;
texts.2.29: O horror! this it is, my dearest, this;
texts.2.30: So pray for me, my friends, who have not strength to pray.
texts.3.1: KYRIE eleison, Christe eleison, Kyrie eleison.
texts.3.3: All holy Angels, pray for him.
texts.3.4: Choirs of the righteous, pray for him.
texts.3.6: St John Baptist, St Joseph, pray for him.
texts.3.7: St Peter, St Paul, St Andrew, St John,
texts.3.8: All Apostles, all Evangelists, pray for him.
texts.3.9: All holy Disciples of the Lord, pray for him.
texts.3.10: All holy Innocents, pray for him.
texts.3.11: All holy Martyrs, all holy Confessors,
texts.3.12: All holy Hermits, all holy Virgins,
texts.3.13: All ye Saints of God, pray for him.
texts.3.15: ROUSE thee, my fainting soul, and play the man;
texts.3.16: And through such waning span Of life and thought as still has to be trod,
texts.3.18: And while the storm of that bewilderment Is for a season spent,
texts.3.19: And, ere afresh the ruin on thee fall, Use well the interval.
texts.3.21: BE merciful, be gracious; spare him, Lord.
texts.3.22: Be merciful, be gracious; Lord, deliver him.
texts.3.23: From the sins that are past;
texts.3.24: From Thy frown and Thine ire;
texts.3.28: His God, or relying, On self, at the last;
texts.3.34: By Thy birth, and by Thy Cross,
texts.3.37: Save him from a final fall;
texts.3.38: By Thy rising from the tomb, By Thy mounting up above,
texts.3.40: Save him in the day of doom.
texts.3.46: Firmly I believe and truly God is Three, and God is One;
texts.3.47: And I next acknowledge duly Manhood taken by the Son.
texts.3.48: And I trust and hope most fully In that Manhood crucified;
texts.3.49: And each thought and deed unruly Do to death, as He has died.
texts.3.50: Simply to His grace and wholly Light and life and strength belong,
texts.3.51: And I love, supremely, solely, Him the holy, Him the strong.
texts.3.57: For the love of Him alone,
texts.3.58: Holy Church, as His creation, And her teachings, as His own.
texts.3.59: And I take with joy whatever Now besets me, pain or fear,
texts.3.60: And with a strong will I sever All the ties which bind me here.
texts.3.62: With and through the angelic host, To the God of earth and heaven,
texts.3.68: I can no more; for now it comes again,
texts.3.69: That sense of ruin, which is worse than pain,
texts.3.71: Of all that makes me man; as though I bent
texts.3.75: Down, down for ever I was falling through
texts.3.76: The solid framework of created things,
texts.3.77: And needs must sink and sink
texts.3.78: Into the vast abyss. And, crueler still,
texts.3.79: A fierce and restless fright begins to fill
texts.3.80: The mansion of my soul. And, worse and worse,
texts.3.82: Floats on the wind, with many a loathsome curse
texts.3.83: Tainting the hallowed air, and laughs, and flaps
texts.3.85: And makes me wild with horror and dismay.
texts.3.86: Jesu, help! pray for me, Mary, pray!
texts.3.87: Some angel, Jesu such as came to Thee
texts.4.1: RESCUE him, O Lord, in this his evil hour,
texts.4.2: As of old so many by Thy gracious power:(Amen.)
texts.4.3: Enoch and Elias from the common doom; (Amen.)
texts.4.4: Noe from the waters in a saving home; (Amen.) Abraham from th' abounding guilt of Heathenesse; (Amen.)
texts.4.5: Job from all his multiform and fell distress; (Amen.)
texts.4.6: Isaac, when his father's knife was raised to slay; (Amen.)
texts.4.7: Lot from burning Sodom on its judgment-day; (Amen.)
texts.4.8: Moses from the land of bondage and despair; (Amen.)
texts.4.9: Daniel from the hungry lions in their lair; (Amen.)
texts.4.10: And the Children Three amid the furnace-flame; (Amen.)
texts.4.11: Chaste Susanna from the slander and the shame; (Amen.)
texts.4.12: David from Golia and the wrath of Saul (Amen.)
texts.4.13: And the two Apostles from the prison-thrall; (Amen.)
texts.4.15: so, to show Thy power, Rescue this Thy servant in his evil hour.
texts.4.17: NOVISSIMA hora est; and I fain would sleep,
texts.4.18: The pain has wearied me.... Into Thy hands
texts.5.1: PROFICISCERE, anima Christiana, de hoc mundo!
texts.5.2: Go forth upon thy journey, Christian soul!
texts.5.3: Go from this world! Go, in the name of God
texts.5.4: The omnipotent Father, who created thee!
texts.5.5: Go, in the name of Jesus Christ, our Lord,
texts.5.6: Son of the living God, who bled for thee!
texts.5.7: Go, in the name of the Holy Spirit, who
texts.5.8: Hath been poured out on thee! Go, in the name
texts.5.9: Of Angels and Archangels; in the name
texts.5.10: Of Thrones and Dominations; in the name
texts.5.11: Of Princedoms and of Powers; and in the name
texts.5.12: Of Cherubim and Seraphim, go forth!
texts.5.13: Go, in the name of Patriarchs and Prophets; And of Apostles and Evangelists,
texts.5.14: Of Martyrs and Confessors; in the name
texts.5.15: Of holy Monks and Hermits; in the name
texts.5.16: Of holy Virgins; and all Saints of God,
texts.5.17: Both men and women, go Go on thy course;
texts.5.18: And may thy place to-day be found in peace,
texts.5.19: And may thy dwelling be the Holy Mount
texts.5.20: Of Sion:--through the Same, through Christ, our Lord.
texts.6.1: I WENT to sleep; and now I am refreshed.
texts.6.2: A strange refreshment: for I feel in me
texts.6.3: An inexpressive lightness, and a sense
texts.6.4: Of freedom, as I were at length myself

texts.16.1: JESU! by that shuddering dread which fell on Thee;
texts.16.2: Jesu! by that cold dismay which sickened Thee;
texts.16.3: Jesu! by that pang of heart which thrilled in Thee;
texts.16.4: Jesu! by that mount of sins which crippled Thee;
texts.16.5: Jesul by that sense of guilt which stifled Thee;
texts.16.6: Jesu! by that innocence which girdled Thee;
texts.16.7: Jesu! by that sanctity which reigned in Thee;
texts.16.8: Jesu! by that Godhead which was one with Thee;
texts.16.9: Jesu! spare these souls which are so dear to Thee,
texts.16.10: Who in prison, calm and patient, wait for Thee;
texts.16.11: Hasten, Lord, their hour, and bid them come to Thee,
texts.16.12: To that glorious Home, where they shall ever gaze on Thee.

texts.18.1: 1. LORD, Thou hast been our refuge: in every generation;
texts.18.2: 2. Before the hills were born, and the world was: from age to age thou art God.
texts.18.3: 3. Bring us not, Lord, very low: for Thou hast said, Come back again, ye sons of Adam.
texts.18.4: 4. A thousand years before Thine eyes are but as yesterday: and as a watch of the night which is come and gone.
texts.18.5: 5. The grass springs up in the morning: at evening-tide it shrivels up and dies.
texts.18.6: 6. So we fail in Thine anger: and in Thy wrath we are troubled.
texts.18.7: 7. Thou hast set our sins in Thy sight: and our round of days in the light of Thy countenance.
texts.18.8: 8. Come back, O Lord! how long: and be entreated for Thy servants.
texts.18.9: 9. In Thy morning we shall be filled with Thy mercy: we shall rejoice and be in pleasure all our days.
texts.18.10: 10. We shall be glad according to the days ot our humiliation: and the years in which we have seen evil.
texts.18.11: 11. Look, O Lord, upon Thy servants and on Thy work: and direct their children.
texts.18.12: 12. And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and the work of our hands, establish Thou it.
texts.18.13: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son: and to the Holy Ghost.
texts.18.14: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be: world without end. Amen.
texts.18.17: In my most loving arms I now enfold thee,
texts.18.18: And, o'er the penal waters, as they roll,
texts.18.19: I poise thee, and I lower thee, and hold thee.
texts.18.20: And carefully I dip thee in the lake,
texts.18.21: And thou, without a sob or a resistance,
texts.18.22: Dost through the flood thy rapid passage take,
texts.18.23: Sinking deep, deeper, into the dim distance.
texts.18.24: Angels, to whom the willing task is given,
texts.18.25: Shall tend, and nurse, and lull thee, as thou liest;
texts.18.26: And Masses on the earth and prayers in heaven,
texts.18.27: Shall aid thee at the Throne of the most Highest.
texts.18.28: Farewell, but not forever! Brother dear,
texts.18.29: Be brave and patient on thy bed of sorrow;
texts.18.30: Swiftly shall pass thy night of trial here,
texts.18.31: And I will come and wake thee on the morrow.
